assumption: A result being available can remain operationally unacknowledged or unowned across local workflows.
why_it_matters: This is the core gap ContinuumOS is intended to make visible; result availability must not be equated with clinical review.
proposed_validation_method: Review representative workflow scenarios with clinical and coordination users; test whether acknowledgement status and ownership can be identified without a shared episode view.
accountable_owner: Product owner and Care Coordinator representative
validation_timing: Before any pilot or production claim

assumption: Cross-setting handoffs can leave the next action without a visible accountable owner.
why_it_matters: The shared episode model is valuable only if it exposes ownership gaps across clinic diagnostics referral and selected administrative work.
proposed_validation_method: Validate the ownership model against walkthroughs of clinic management day-care referral and hospital-escalation scenarios.
accountable_owner: Product owner and Care Coordinator representative

assumption: An explicit exception queue is needed for uncertain linkage incomplete results duplicate events and integration recovery.
why_it_matters: Without a visible exception route uncertain or incomplete information may be handled informally or silently attached.
proposed_validation_method: Run synthetic failure scenarios and confirm that each exception receives an owner age resolution action and safe return state.
accountable_owner: Care Coordinator representative and product owner

assumption: A clinician-facing SMART on FHIR launch can provide enough useful episode context to begin the proposed workflow without replacing the system of record.
why_it_matters: D02 records the design choice to use a SMART on FHIR demonstration. This assumption tests whether that launch gives clinicians enough useful context and reduces unnecessary context switching.
proposed_validation_method: Test the synthetic launch flow with defined episode-context retrieval and collect structured usability feedback before making any usability claim.

assumption: Source-linked AI episode summarisation can present relevant episode facts accurately enough to support human review and handoff preparation.
why_it_matters: Summarisation is useful only when material facts are traceable to approved sources and do not introduce unsupported content.
proposed_validation_method: Evaluate assertion-level source-linkage accuracy and critical unsupported-statement rate on labelled synthetic cases.
accountable_owner: Product owner; Clinic physician; Referral Coordinator

assumption: A future operational-attention recommendation may help coordinators act earlier without becoming clinical prioritisation.
why_it_matters: This is not a seven-day MVP capability. Any later evaluation must use deterministic workflow signals such as ageing unresolved exceptions and repeated handoffs and must not imply a predictive clinical-risk model or replace clinician authority.
proposed_validation_method: Evaluate only after the two-capability MVP has been validated; measure coordinator-confirmed usefulness, override and documented follow-up action.
accountable_owner: Care Coordinator representative and product owner

assumption: An AI-generated source-linked referral handoff draft can reduce preparation effort after clinician approval while remaining subject to human review.
why_it_matters: The draft must improve preparation support without creating sending approval or referral authority.
proposed_validation_method: Evaluate pre-edit package completeness material correction rate approval evidence and preparation time against a defined synthetic workflow.
accountable_owner: Referral Coordinator representative and product owner

assumption: Selected planned escalation pathways may require financial-readiness work before administrative confirmation while urgent clinical care must not be delayed by this workflow.
why_it_matters: Financial readiness is a supporting dependency on selected paths; it must not become an autonomous decision or delay urgent clinical care.
proposed_validation_method: Validate pathway-specific prerequisite ordering exception handling and urgent-care bypass conditions with synthetic walkthroughs and authorised operational input.

assumption: Documented post-confirmation patient communication is necessary for a next step to be operationally complete.
why_it_matters: A handoff is not fully closed if communication status approved content sender and timing are unknown.
proposed_validation_method: Validate the required communication evidence fields against synthetic scenarios and later stakeholder review.

assumption: Uncertain patient encounter or event matches can be safely resolved through manual reconciliation rather than silent attachment.
why_it_matters: The MVP must protect against attaching diagnostic information to the wrong synthetic episode.
proposed_validation_method: Exercise patient-match failed encounter-missing duplicate-event and integration-unavailable scenarios; verify human confirmation before safe return.
accountable_owner: Identity reconciliation reviewer and Care Coordinator representative

assumption: An amended diagnostic result requires renewed clinical review and acknowledgement even when an earlier report version was acknowledged.
why_it_matters: Version-aware review prevents prior acknowledgement from being treated as sufficient after source information changes.
proposed_validation_method: Run the amended-result synthetic scenario and verify preserved report versions reopened review and renewed human acknowledgement before downstream progression.
accountable_owner: Clinic physician representative and diagnostic operations representative

assumption: AI missing or conflicting-context detection can identify handoff-relevant gaps in available source information without inventing facts or judging clinical significance.
why_it_matters: This is deferred AI-based anomaly detection, not an MVP capability. Context-gap detection has a different failure mode from summarisation: it may omit a required gap or flag information that is not actually missing or conflicting.
proposed_validation_method: Evaluate precision recall critical-omission rate and error types against a versioned labelled synthetic reference set after the two-capability MVP is validated.
